clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau watched gurus hand out "10 secrets" and "30 steps" for years, and noticed something: none of it made anyone rich.

He compares it to drilling for oil. Ten holes, ten feet each, finds nothing. One hole, drilled hundreds of feet down, finds the treasure and makes you an oil baron.

Most people chase a new book, a new program, a new "30 steps" every month - and never drill deep enough into any single one to strike anything.

Pick one idea. Drill it until it pays you.

Which "next thing" have you been collecting instead of using?
